externals.title: Temporal service
externals.description: External Temporal workflow service reached through the Temporal client/connection boundary.

externals.title: PostgreSQL
externals.description: External PostgreSQL operational persistence used by the PostgreSQL adapter and worker composition roots.

relations.label: HTTP commands / queries
relations.rationale: The web API client dispatches fetch requests to the configured API base URL; the API is a Fastify HTTP application that registers protected runtime routes.

relations.label: PlannerFacade / plan compile
relations.rationale: The start-run application composition creates PlannerFacade and the planner-backed plan compile rail.

relations.label: workflow engine + start-run rail
relations.rationale: The protected execution composition builds the workflow engine; the API composition root then passes that concrete engine into the start-run application boundary.

relations.label: start-run backpressure admission
relations.rationale: The API admission runtime constructs the delivery-owned StartRunAdmissionGuard; the protected runtime composition injects that guard into the start-run boundary.

relations.label: state / intent / plan stores
relations.rationale: The API composition dynamically loads PostgreSQL adapter types and constructs state, intent and plan stores.

relations.label: Temporal IProviderAdapter binding
relations.rationale: The API provider-adapter factory loads @dvt/adapter-temporal and returns a concrete TemporalAdapter behind the engine provider boundary.

relations.label: IProviderAdapter.startRun → Temporal binding
relations.rationale: Engine start-run resolves an injected provider adapter and delegates startRun; API composition binds the temporal provider to TemporalAdapter.

relations.label: run state via injected store roles
relations.rationale: Engine writes through injected run-state roles; API composition binds those roles to PostgresStateStoreAdapter.

relations.label: Temporal client / workflow service
relations.rationale: TemporalClientManager opens a Temporal Connection and Client using configured address and namespace.

relations.label: SQL / operational persistence
relations.rationale: The PostgreSQL adapter creates observed pg Pool instances used by adapter runtime components.

relations.label: TemporalWorkerHost + plugin registry
relations.rationale: The Temporal worker composition instantiates TemporalWorkerHost and composes adapter-owned step-plugin registries.

relations.label: DBT step activity profile
relations.rationale: The Temporal worker explicitly constructs the DBT plugin runner and step activity registry.

relations.label: HTTP JSON acquisition profile
relations.rationale: The Temporal worker explicitly constructs the HTTP JSON plugin runner and profile.

relations.label: object-file → PostgreSQL profile
relations.rationale: The Temporal worker explicitly constructs the object-file PostgreSQL plugin runner and profile.

relations.label: PostgresObjectFileLoadingCapability
relations.rationale: The object-file worker profile binds the plugin's relational loader to the PostgreSQL adapter capability.

relations.label: OutboxWorkerRuntime
relations.rationale: The outbox worker composition runs the delivery-owned OutboxWorkerRuntime.

relations.label: outbox state / claims / retries
relations.rationale: The outbox worker constructs PostgresStateStoreAdapter and passes it to OutboxWorkerRuntime.

relations.label: ProjectorWorkerRuntime
relations.rationale: The projector worker composition runs the delivery-owned projector runtime.

relations.label: snapshot projection state
relations.rationale: The projector worker constructs PostgresStateStoreAdapter and gives it to ProjectorWorkerRuntime.

relations.label: LineageWorkerRuntime + OpenLineage sink
relations.rationale: The lineage worker runs LineageWorkerRuntime and composes the traceability-owned HTTP OpenLineage sink.

relations.label: lineage outbox / state
relations.rationale: The lineage worker bootstrap constructs PostgresStateStoreAdapter and exposes its lineage outbox store.
